dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregularly shaped rings and arcs with light-colored perimeters contrasting against a dark base coat. The geometry exhibits crenulated edges with a sharp transition from the dark exterior to a high-intensity light border, often enclosing a dark interior region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of small, solid, high-intensity pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, scattered primarily in the interstitial spaces between larger ring structures and along the peripheral dorsal edges.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the five most prominent dorsal-central annuli form an irregular pentagonal arrangement; a secondary chain of three smaller centroids forms an obtuse triangle on the upper-right lateral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A vertical series of small, pale, dash-like marks or indentations is visible on the far left lateral flank near the flipper junction.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense, fine-grained, high-intensity punctate speckling is concentrated on the visible surfaces of the lateral flipper extremities.
